info.title: CropCard External Agent API
info.description:
Owner-scoped JSON API for external Claude agents and SaaS integrations (Phase 24, UC-43). Bearer tokens minted at `/settings/api-tokens`. Safety kernel re-runs on every state-changing call — agents cannot bypass tenant isolation, the 48h spray lock, helper custom-rate restrictions, or kernel violations regardless of which endpoint they hit.

Coverage is incremental: Phase 24 shipped auth, health, spray/record and blocks; Phase 30 adds Areas, blocks and garden beds, the garden designer, offline Cards, geocoding, first-use hints and the offline-safe record endpoints. Additional endpoints adopt the OpenAPI registry in domain batches — track open work in [docs/phase-24-agent-api.md](https://github.com/mrpeanut01/crop-card/blob/main/docs/phase-24-agent-api.md).

servers.description: Relative to wherever CropCard is hosted. The same path works against `localhost:5173` in dev and the deployed Azure Container App in prod.

bearerAuth.description: Owner-scoped Bearer token. Mint at `/settings/api-tokens`. CSRF Origin check is bypassed for `/api/**` Bearer requests; cookie sessions still enforce same-origin.

cookieSession.name: cropcard.session
cookieSession.description: HMAC-signed session cookie set by `/signin`. Cookie mutations under `/api/**` require matching Origin.

ClientRecordId.name: x-cropcard-client-record-id
ClientRecordId.description: Offline-queue row id (8 to 80 of `A-Z a-z 0-9 _ -`). A replay of an id the active Owner already saved answers 200 `{ ok: true, duplicate: true }` and writes nothing, so a record is saved at most once. Omit it for a plain request; an id that does not match the pattern is ignored.

PlacedPlanting.description: A planting placed in a bed. `plantCountProvenance` and `sourceProvenance` say where a value came from; a hand-placed planting has no `sourceProvenance`.

get.description: Public; no auth required. Returns the running safety-kernel rules version + uptime.
Public; no auth required. Returns the OpenAPI 3.1 description of the agent-facing surface.

post.summary: Mint a new owner-scoped Bearer token
post.description: Cookie-session ONLY (a Bearer token cannot mint another Bearer — closes the bootstrap loop on a leaked credential). Plaintext is returned **once** in the response; the DB only sees sha256(plaintext).

isServiceAccount.description: When true, AI rate-limit keys on (tokenId, endpoint) instead of (userId, endpoint) — protects the human owner from a runaway agent.

get.description: Never returns plaintext (the DB does not have it). Owner role required.

delete.description: Composite (owner_id, id) gate — an Owner cannot revoke another Owner's token. Immediate: next Bearer request → 401.

post.description: Every POST re-runs `evaluateSpray()` on the server regardless of UI. A Bearer-authed agent cannot bypass the safety kernel, the 48h spray lock, the helper custom-rate restriction, or tenant isolation. Returns 422 with kernel violations on safety failure.

get.summary: List Areas for the active Owner
get.description: Areas (stored as fields) with their block counts and acres. Tenant-scoped; helpers can read.

parameters.name: kind
parameters.description: Comma-separated kinds to include (`field`, `garden`, `greenhouse`, `orchard`, `pasture`, `barn`, `residence`, `natural_area`, `water`, `boundary`). An unknown kind returns 400.

post.description: Owner only. `details` is checked against the schema for `kind` (garden watering, greenhouse structure, orchard spacing and so on) and rejected with 400 when it does not fit.

400.description: Invalid body, or `details` that do not fit the kind.

403.description: Owner role required. Helpers can read but not change this.

404.description: Area not found for the active Owner.

patch.description: Owner only. Null clears a value. Reshaping a garden or greenhouse that would leave a bed outside its edge answers 409 `OUTSIDE_AREA`.

400.description: Invalid body, or `details` that do not fit the kind.

403.description: Owner role required. Helpers can read but not change this.

404.description: Area not found for the active Owner.

409.description: A bed would end up outside the Area.

delete.summary: Delete an Area and everything in it
delete.description: Owner only. Cascades through every block, planting and event in the Area.

200.description: Deleted; the body counts what was removed.

403.description: Owner role required. Helpers can read but not change this.

404.description: Area not found for the active Owner.

get.summary: List blocks for the active Owner
get.description: Tenant-scoped via `runWithTenantAsync(activeOwnerId, …)`. Bearer tokens see only the Owner they were minted under.

parameters.name: kind
parameters.description: Comma-separated kinds to include (`block`, `bed`, `row`, `container`). An unknown kind returns 400.

post.summary: Create a block, bed, row or container
post.description: Owner only. Designer layout fields (`xFt`, `yFt`, `rotationDeg`, `bedStyle`) are in feet from the Area corner and only apply to beds and containers in a garden or greenhouse. A bed that overlaps another or leaves the Area answers 409 `OVERLAP` or `OUTSIDE_AREA`.

rotationDeg.description: Degrees, a multiple of 90; saved as 0, 90, 180 or 270.

400.description: Invalid body, or a kind that cannot sit in that Area.

403.description: Owner role required. Helpers can read but not change this.

get.summary: Fetch one block with its plantings

404.description: Block not found for the active Owner.

patch.summary: Move, resize, rotate or rename a block
patch.description: Owner only. Null clears a value. Shrinking a bed past a planting answers 409; finished plantings are clamped to the new size.

anyOf.description: Degrees, a multiple of 90; saved as 0, 90, 180 or 270.

400.description: Invalid body, an unknown `fieldId`, or a kind that cannot sit there.

403.description: Owner role required. Helpers can read but not change this.

404.description: Block not found for the active Owner.

409.description: The new layout does not fit.

delete.description: Owner only. Cascades through its plantings and events. With `?ifEmpty=1` (the garden designer) a block holding anything but planned plantings is kept and the answer is 409 `BED_HAS_RECORDS`.

200.description: Deleted; the body counts what was removed.

403.description: Owner role required. Helpers can read but not change this.

404.description: Block not found for the active Owner.

post.summary: Plant into garden beds as one batch
post.description: Owner only. Creates `planned` plantings in beds. Every item is checked before anything is written, so one bad item saves nothing. `source` records where each proposal came from and is stored as its provenance.

403.description: Owner role required. Helpers can read but not change this.

404.description: Bed not found for the active Owner.

409.description: The layout does not fit: `OVERLAP`, `OUTSIDE_AREA` or `NOT_DESIGNABLE`.

post.description: Owner only. `commit: false` previews the sowings that fit after a planting; `commit: true` saves them linked as one succession group.

403.description: Owner role required. Helpers can read but not change this.

404.description: Bed not found for the active Owner.

409.description: The layout does not fit: `OVERLAP`, `OUTSIDE_AREA` or `NOT_DESIGNABLE`.

post.summary: Propose plantings for the free space in a bed
post.description: Owner only. Never saves anything; accepted proposals go to `POST /api/garden/plantings`. Claude is asked only when it is available (through `aiTry()`); otherwise, or when its answer fails the server checks, the proposals come from the best-fitting bed recipe or a spacing-packed plan and are tagged `fallback`, with `fallbackReason` saying why.

403.description: Owner role required. Helpers can read but not change this.

404.description: Bed not found for the active Owner.

409.description: The layout does not fit: `OVERLAP`, `OUTSIDE_AREA` or `NOT_DESIGNABLE`.

get.summary: The active Owner's offline Card bundle
get.description: Everything the offline Cards need, built from tenant-scoped reads: Areas, blocks, plantings, open tasks, equipment, stock, crop and spray product data, frost dates and the Farm Map Card emergency contacts. Helpers can read it. Sends a weak ETag and answers 304 to a matching `If-None-Match`.

frost.description: Frost dates with their provenance (`data`, `manual` or `fallback`).

304.description: Unchanged since the ETag you sent.

get.description: Signed-in only. Asks the US Census geocoder for up to 5 matches. Limited to 20 lookups a minute per user.

200.description: Matches, best first. Empty when nothing matched or the lookup failed.

400.description: `q` is missing, too short or too long.

429.description: Too many lookups; try again in a minute.

get.summary: First-use hints the signed-in user has dismissed

post.description: One `key`, or a batch of up to 50 `keys` (the client flushes offline dismissals this way). Answers with the full dismissed list.

409.description: Too many hints recorded for this user.
